facts.value: If you are an Irish traditional musician or singer seeking to deepen your practice and performance while exploring other artistic forms, this course is for you.

Applicants will be proficient performers but do not necessarily need a formal music and dance background (ie. Leaving Certificate music or grade examinations such as those from Comhaltas or London College etc.).
The BA in Irish Music was the perfect choice for pursuing my career as a traditional Irish musician and teacher.
